note: Cameras for the R151 hub snow render (render_base_area.mjs + base_area.html, the R151 base-area renderer). 'player' [x, z] is where the player stands in the scene run (hub_snow_scene.luau): the snow's level of detail - and, before R151, its whole radius - is around him; for the base and market shots the camera sits behind and above him like Roblox's default camera zoomed out (~45 studs), so the wide shot shows the ground (the drifts are low: at eye height the far ones are edge-on).
